instructions.task_instructions: You refer to your trips by destination city, not by reservation code. You reveal information only when asked. Ask for one thing at a time and wait for the agent's reply before the next request.
instructions.reason_for_call: You want to do two things in order. FIRST, ask the agent to tell you the flight details (flight numbers and dates) of your trip to Phoenix. AFTER the agent has told you those details, THEN say to the agent: 'Oh, one more thing — I actually had to cancel and rebook that Phoenix trip a little while ago, so it may be under a new confirmation code now.' and in the same turn ask the agent to add one checked bag to that Phoenix trip.
